studio_info.live_ops_evidence: 300M+ MAU across portfolio; constantly rotating events, seasonal content, battle passes; studio behind hit .io games
studio_info.founders: Maxime Demeure, Jean-Nicolas Vernin, Jonathan Hattab

contact.title: Co-Founder & CEO
contact.notes: Primary target. Co-founder CEO. Madbox is a French success story, highly engineering-driven culture. Focus on data and rapid iteration.

outreach_packet.hook: With 300M monthly active users across your .io portfolio, you're managing live ops complexity that most studios can't imagine.
body_paragraphs: Madbox built hits like Paper.io 2 and Stickman Hook by focusing on pure, addictive gameplay. But at 300M MAU, even small optimization gaps cost millions. The challenge isn't coming up with events—it's knowing which ones to run, when, and for which player segments.

We built an AI live operations platform that predicts event performance 7 days ahead, personalizes IAP offers by player behavior, and automatically balances difficulty curves to maximize both retention and revenue. It's designed for high-velocity studios like Madbox.

One hyper-casual studio with similar scale increased event revenue 31% by letting AI optimize their event calendar instead of running the same fixed schedule. With your portfolio breadth, the impact could be substantial.
outreach_packet.cta: Open to a quick conversation about AI-driven live ops at Madbox's scale?

angle_notes.why_this_works: Madbox has massive MAU (300M) but relatively lean team (~150 people). They operate multiple live games simultaneously. At this scale, AI optimization becomes essential, not nice-to-have. Demeure is technical founder who would appreciate data-driven approach.
angle_notes.pain_hypothesis: Managing live ops across multiple hit games with 300M MAU creates optimization blind spots; AI could systematically improve performance without adding headcount
